relics.name: Lucky Box
relics.description: Raises luck and score rewards while owned. Adds critical hit chance: successful direct hits deal double damage. Does not make trails or lingering damage critical. Owned passive bonuses apply once, including while combined.

relics.name: Monkey's Paw
relics.description: Raises luck, damage and movement speed while owned. Its bonuses are fixed; it does not roll random penalties. Adds critical hit chance: successful direct hits deal double damage. Does not make trails or lingering damage critical. Owned passive bonuses apply once, including while combined.

relics.name: Echo Prism
relics.description: Raises damage and score rewards while owned. It does not repeat attacks; combine it to add its damage bonus to a build. Adds critical hit chance: successful direct hits deal double damage. Does not make trails or lingering damage critical. Owned passive bonuses apply once, including while combined.

relics.name: Iron Nest
relics.description: Raises maximum health and defense while owned, at the cost of movement speed. Owned passive bonuses apply once, including while combined.

relics.name: Glass Heart
relics.description: Raises maximum health, luck and health restoration while owned. Improves healing casts and damage-to-health conversion, but does not increase shields or grant a healing ability. Owned passive bonuses apply once, including while combined.

relics.name: Void Bell
relics.description: Raises damage, luck and score rewards while owned. Adds critical hit chance: successful direct hits deal double damage. Does not make trails or lingering damage critical. Owned passive bonuses apply once, including while combined.

relics.name: Lucky Box
relics.description: A stronger fortune relic that raises luck and damage while owned. Owned passive bonuses apply once, including while combined.

relics.name: Chaos Core
relics.description: Raises luck, damage and movement speed while owned. A fixed legendary bonus rather than a random effect. Owned passive bonuses apply once, including while combined.

relics.name: Moon Sigil
relics.description: Raises luck, damage and movement speed while owned. Owned passive bonuses apply once, including while combined.

relics.name: Inferno Core
relics.description: Raises damage and luck while owned. Combine with a weapon, projectile ability, moving sentry or teleport to leave fire trails. Each patch lasts two seconds and deals fire damage to enemies inside it. Owned passive bonuses apply once, including while combined.

relics.name: Shimmer Petal
relics.description: Raises luck and movement speed while owned. Owned passive bonuses apply once, including while combined.

relics.name: Ricochet Amulet
relics.description: Increases damage and luck while owned. Combine with a weapon or projectile ability to make its shots bounce to another enemy. Owned passive bonuses apply once, including while combined.

relics.name: Sentinel Heart
relics.description: Raises maximum health, defense and luck while owned. This relic does not summon a sentinel. Owned passive bonuses apply once, including while combined.

relics.name: Ember Gloves
relics.description: Gloves that burn with ember power.

relics.name: Sentry Lattice
relics.description: Raises maximum health, damage and luck while owned. This relic does not summon or shield a sentry. Owned passive bonuses apply once, including while combined.

relics.name: Horde Beacon
relics.description: While owned, calls larger, stronger hordes with higher score and XP rewards. Multiple beacons stack. Sell it to ease pressure; currency grows more slowly than danger.
